description: This file is a Lua script containing multiple test functions designed to stress test Lua's parser, memory management, and error handling capabilities. It includes functions that generate large strings, deep control structures, excessive instructions, constants, strings, and index tables to provoke errors such as overflows and resource limits.

methods.name: teststring
methods.description: Tests the behavior of string length limits and memory overflow handling in Lua.

methods.name: loadrep
methods.description: Creates a large string by repeating a character and loads it as a chunk to test memory handling.

methods.name: controlstruct
methods.description: Creates a deeply nested control structure to test maximum length limits.

methods.name: manylines
methods.description: Attempts to load a chunk with too many lines to test line limit handling.

methods.name: hugeid
methods.description: Loads a chunk with an excessively long identifier to test lexer limits.

methods.name: toomanyinst
methods.description: Loads a chunk with too many instructions to test instruction limit handling.

methods.name: loadrepfunc
methods.description: Loads a function with many constants or instructions to test internal limits.

methods.name: toomanyconst
methods.description: Creates a function with too many constants to test constant pool limits.

methods.name: toomanystr
methods.description: Creates many string objects to test string handling limits.

methods.name: toomanyidx
methods.description: Creates a table with many indices to test indexing limits.
